context: Two managers debrief after an evaluation committee
purpose: Teach: 算定/暫定/安価/付与/除外/評議/総括/助教授

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今日の評議会、お疲れさまでした。まずは総括から始めましょうか。
lines.en: Good work at today's evaluation committee. Shall we start with the overall summary?
lines.style: Composed professional tone, opening a structured debrief calmly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ。例の助教授の研究費、算定の根拠がちょっと弱かった印象です。
lines.en: Yes. That associate professor's research budget — the calculation basis felt a bit weak.
lines.style: Measured and analytical, voicing a concern with professional restraint.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同感です。とりあえず暫定の数字で進めて、来月までに見直しましょう。
lines.en: I agree. Let's proceed with provisional figures and review them by next month.
lines.style: Pragmatic decision-making voice, offering a clear interim plan.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それと、安価な外注に切り替える案、評価対象から除外していいですよね？
lines.en: Also, the proposal to switch to cheaper outsourcing — we can exclude it from review, right?
lines.style: Confirming tone seeking quick alignment on a procedural matter.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: はい、品質基準を満たさないので除外で構いません。記録にもそう残します。
lines.en: Yes, it doesn't meet our quality standards, so excluding it is fine. I'll note that.
lines.style: Decisive and authoritative, closing the matter with documentation in mind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 助かります。あと、優秀者への追加予算の付与、これは部長承認が必要ですね。
lines.en: Thanks. Also, granting extra budget to top performers — that needs the director's approval.
lines.style: Procedurally cautious, flagging an escalation requirement matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ですね。明日の朝一で稟議を回します。総括レポートは金曜までに仕上げますので。
lines.en: Right. I'll circulate the approval request first thing tomorrow. I'll finish the summary report by Friday.
lines.style: Forward-looking and committed, wrapping up with concrete next actions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 完璧です。今日はもう遅いので、続きは明日にしましょう。お先にどうぞ。
lines.en: Perfect. It's late already, so let's continue tomorrow. Please head out first.
lines.style: Warm but professional close, considerate of colleague's time.
